title: Vantaa and Kerava: €326,600 a year, about 1.3 lung cancer deaths avoided a year (modelled)
markdown:
# Vantaa and Kerava: €326,600 a year, about 1.3 lung cancer deaths avoided a year (modelled)

> About 1.3 deaths avoided a year (modelled) · €326,600 of €1.00M · €673,400 left: nothing else pays off at these assumptions

## The gap

Of 100 lung cancer patients in Vantaa and Kerava, 36 get treatment that aims to cure. In Finland it is 27. No stage of the care path is below the national level beyond chance. [^care_curative] There is no shortfall. [^care_curative] [^model] Vantaa and Kerava treats more patients to cure than Finland as a whole, at or above the best quarter of counties. [^care_curative] [^model] This plan therefore ranks measures by deaths avoided instead. [^model] Recorded drug therapy is 3.5% of patients here against 25.1% nationally, so some treatment given may not be on record. [^care_drug_therapy]

## The target

This plan is ranked by deaths avoided: about 1.3 a year (range −0.1 to 3.9), for €326,600 a year. [^model] Deaths avoided are modelled from stated assumptions, not observed. [^model] The low end is below zero: how much delay adds to lung cancer deaths is not statistically certain, so no benefit cannot be ruled out. [^model]

## Funded actions

| # | Action and owner | Cost a year | Deaths avoided a year (range) | First step this week | Measure: today → target |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | **Step zero: fix the records (no direct effect)** | | | | |
| 0 | **Check the charts of patients with no treatment on record**[^ev_recording_audit_1]. Chief physician of oncology and the head of clinical coding | €8,000 | 0.0 | Pull 50 patients diagnosed in 2023 with no treatment on record and check their charts this month. | Share of patients with no treatment on record: 28.9% → 27.5% by 2027 |
| | **The county can start on Monday** | | | | |
| 1 | **Same-day chest X-ray report with immediate CT**[^ev_same_day_cxr_ct_1]. Chief radiologist together with the chief physician of primary care | €109,000 | 0.5 (−0.0 to 1.9) | Agree with radiology that a suspicious chest X-ray is followed by CT the same day, without a new referral. | Days from suspicious chest X-ray to CT: not published today → 3 days by 2027 |
| 2 | **Smoking cessation started at the first specialist visit**[^ev_smoking_cessation_at_diagnosis_1]. Chief physician and head nurse of pulmonology | €48,600 | 0.4 (0.1–0.8) | Write the standing order: every smoker with suspected lung cancer leaves the first visit with cessation medicine and a nurse call booked. | Share of smoking patients given cessation medicine at the first visit: not published today → 90% by 2027 |
| 3 | **Standardised lung cancer pathway with booked slots**[^ev_cpp_pathway_1]. Chief physician of pulmonology (county pathway); FICAN and the national lung cancer group (national pathway description) | €100,000 | 0.3 (−0.2 to 1.1) | Name one pathway owner and book fixed weekly CT, PET-CT, bronchoscopy and MDT slots for suspected lung cancer. | Days from diagnosis to start of treatment (median): 39.4 days → 36.9 days by 2028 |
| 4 | **Nurse navigator for every suspected lung cancer**[^ev_nurse_navigator_1]. Head nurses of pulmonology and oncology; director of nursing | €61,000 | 0.1 (0.0–0.1) | Name one nurse who books every test for each new suspected lung cancer patient and calls the patient with the dates. | Days from diagnosis to start of treatment (median): 39.4 days → 36.9 days by 2028 |
| | **Total** | **€326,600** | **1.3 (−0.1 to 3.9)** | | |

Effects are modelled from published studies and stated assumptions, not observed here. Costs are assumptions. [^model]

## Needs a national decision (outside this budget)

- **Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers**[^ev_ldct_screening_1]: Ministry of Social Affairs and Health and Palko (decision), Finnish Cancer Registry (steering), county (delivery). €895,169 a year; modelled to avoid 1.5 deaths a year (0.3–4.0). Not counted in this budget. Not a county decision. Ask the Ministry and Palko for the timetable after the 2026-2028 pilot and offer the county as a pilot site. [^model]

## What to measure from Monday

- Share of patients with no treatment on record: 28.9% → 27.5% by 2027. [^care_no_record][^model]
- Days from suspicious chest X-ray to CT: not published today → 3 days by 2027. [^model]
- Share of smoking patients given cessation medicine at the first visit: not published today → 90% by 2027. [^model]
- Days from diagnosis to start of treatment (median): 39.4 days → 36.9 days by 2028. [^care_time_to_treatment][^model]
- The registry's public figures cover 2019–2023; count these each month from the county's own records. [^care_curative]

## What more money buys, and what it cannot

The €673,400 left buys nothing more. [^model] €326,600 funds every measure that adds deaths avoided, and five others cost more per death avoided than the plan's limit. [^model] Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers needs a national decision. [^model] Lung cancer causes about 88 deaths a year in Vantaa and Kerava, and this plan is modelled to avoid 1.3 of them (range -0.12 to 3.88). [^deaths] [^model]

## Limits

- Effects are modelled from stated assumptions, not observed. Each range runs from all assumptions at their lowest to all at their highest, and is not a probability. [^model]
- Shares are adjusted only for residents aged 65 or over, not for stage at diagnosis, other illness, histology or smoking. County figures cannot show cause. [^model]
- Recorded drug therapy is 3.5% here against 25.1% nationally. Read this as a gap in the national registers, not as care. [^care_drug_therapy]
